name: 365.fintech
decision_note: Corporate fintech VC of 365.bank (Bratislava) investing at seed across Europe; its latest dated new investment found is Ondato in September 2022, so no activity is shown on/after 2024-10-25.

evidence.quote: We are a fintech venture investor focusing on innovative b2b or b2b2c FinTech, InsurTech and Big Data startups.
We invest in European startups with global ambitions around seed stage.
We are based in CEE but we are investing anywhere in Europe where we see outstanding nascent fintech startups - from London to Riga.
We are delighted to announce that Ondato — a tech company that streamlines KYC and AML-related processes — is joining the 365.fintech portfolio.
We are excited to announce that the UK-based startup Tymit is joining the 365.fintech portfolio.
365.fintech Geography: Slovakia, Europe Preferred industries: FinTech Investment ticket: €50k - €500k Company stage: Seed

analyst_notes: Exclusion E7 (kept as an inactive corporate VC): the newest dated item on 365.fintech's own news feed is Ondato (15 Sep 2022; date from the homepage news list) and the site footer reads '© 2022'; the portfolio also lists Erbeo, Monite, Montonio and Tapline without dates; no dated deal on/after 2024-10-25 was found (web search budget was exhausted before an exhaustive news check, so a 2024-2026 deal reported only in the press cannot be ruled out). Wholly owned by 365.bank, a. s. (IČO 31340890; ORSR extract shows 365.bank as sole shareholder since 28 Jun 2022); not on the NBS fund-manager register (invests from its own balance sheet; SK NACE 70220). Capital = total assets EUR 4,709,654 at 31 Dec 2025 from the 2025 micro-entity balance sheet in RÚZ (filed 11 Jun 2026; prior year EUR 5,141,726); by the MÚJ template the long-term financial assets line is EUR 4,063,678 (2024: 4,025,013), i.e. the book value of its startup and fund stakes - roughly flat, consistent with no material new investing. The 'Big Data' focus is mapped to ai_data. Ticket only from a 2020 Vestbee list (self-reported, class D). Partners/LP positions in Speedinvest, Finch Capital and Startup Wise Guys are fund commitments, not direct investments.
